event.description: a calendar event or recurring series, with its title and description in doc

starts.description: ISO date-time with UTC offset, a local date-time when zone is set, or YYYY-MM-DD for an all-day event

ends.description: exclusive end, in the same date or date-time form as starts; absent means one day for an all-day event, or a point in time

repeats.description: RFC 5545 RRULE, such as FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=SU; timed recurrences follow zone

zone.description: IANA time zone for this event's local times and recurrence, such as America/Detroit; absent means UTC
